With clipping disabled and three previous sigma-LSTM failures, the focused test does not characterize this new near-zero stability risk. No full ReLU-gate run has started.
findings.fix: Add a small positive-score gradient regression check and document the unbounded derivative as a prelaunch risk. Keep the requested exact gate unless the user authorizes a different numerical rule; assess actual training stability from the window-20 run before starting window 80.
